We are a company of skilled Engineers, Accountants, Lawyers, Mathematicians and Investors.


 
 
We Make SOFTWARE

Lacs of people and businesses in India use QuickCompany.in, which has been around since 2014. The company started as a side project to a software nerd. We democratise technology for SMEs / CAs / Lawyers / Analysts, creating innovative products that empower our customers to grow.

 
For Businesses, Accountants, Analysts and Lawyers

Culture

We help our team members grow in their current roles and dream about what's next. QuickCompany employees are encouraged to attend events, share what they do, and take time off to volunteer or learn new skills.

As part of our commitment to diversity and inclusion, we’re cultivating an equitable and empathetic workplace, a listening and learning culture, and an empowered and inspired community.

We also hosts writers, designers, musicians, artists, and other interesting folks regularly. So we stay inspired by people in different industries.
